rules.statement: The abandonment of a temple by a bhikku, who was entitled to succeed to an incumbency, can lead to the forfeiture of that right if such abandonment is clear and unambiguous.
rules.supporting_quote: "The basis of abandonment is the intention to renounce one's rights; and this intention must be clear and unambiguous. If there is any doubt on this matter, the inference drawn must be against an abandonment."

meta.parties: Welakanda Dhammasiddi v. Kamburupitiye Somaloka Thero
